module_summary: RISC-V next-PC predictor: a fully associative BTB, a 2-bit saturating BHT and a speculative return address stack predict the fetch next PC, all trained by resolved branch updates.

anchors.name: next_pc_f_o
anchors.why: Predicted next fetch PC chosen from RAS, BTB target or sequential PC.

anchors.name: pc_f_i
anchors.why: Current fetch PC used for BTB lookup and BHT index.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.btb_pc_q
anchors.why: BTB tag array of branch source PCs matched against fetch PC.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.bht_sat_q
anchors.why: Branch history table of 2-bit saturating counters predicting taken.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.ras_stack_q
anchors.why: Return address stack storing call return PCs for return prediction.

anchors.name: branch_request_i
anchors.why: Resolved branch update triggering BTB learn, RAS and history repair.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.btb_target_q
anchors.why: BTB target array supplying predicted branch target PC.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.btb_valid_r
anchors.why: BTB lookup hit gating prediction, RAS pushes/pops and LFSR hit.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.bht_predict_taken_w
anchors.why: BHT taken prediction selecting BTB target as next PC.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.ras_index_q
anchors.why: Speculative RAS stack pointer selecting predicted return address.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.ras_ret_pred_w
anchors.why: Predicted return selecting RAS top as next PC and popping stack.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.btb_miss_r
anchors.why: Update missed BTB; allocates new entry via LFSR replacement.

anchors.name: pc_accept_i
anchors.why: Fetch accepted PC; qualifies speculative RAS and history updates.

anchors.name: branch_source_i
anchors.why: Resolved branch PC used for BTB tag match, BHT index and RAS push.

anchors.name: next_taken_f_o
anchors.why: Predicted-taken slot indication for the fetched instruction pair.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.btb_next_pc_r
anchors.why: BTB target or sequential PC candidate for next PC mux.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.btb_is_jmp_r
anchors.why: BTB entry is unconditional jump; forces taken prediction.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.btb_hit_r
anchors.why: Update hit existing BTB entry; enables in-place entry update.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.btb_wr_entry_r
anchors.why: Matching BTB entry index for update on hit.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.btb_wr_alloc_w
anchors.why: LFSR-chosen BTB entry index for allocation on miss.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.btb_entry_r
anchors.why: Index of BTB entry hit by fetch lookup, sent to replacement logic.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.bht_wr_entry_w
anchors.why: BHT counter index for training updates.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.bht_rd_entry_w
anchors.why: BHT counter index for fetch prediction.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.global_history_q
anchors.why: Speculative global branch history shift register for gshare indexing.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.global_history_real_q
anchors.why: Committed global history used to repair speculative history.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.ras_index_real_q
anchors.why: Committed RAS pointer restoring speculative pointer on mispredict.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.ras_call_pred_w
anchors.why: Predicted call pushing return address onto RAS.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.ras_pc_pred_w
anchors.why: RAS top-of-stack predicted return address.

anchors.name: BRANCH_PREDICTION.pred_taken_w
anchors.why: Accepted taken prediction shifting speculative global history.

anchors.name: branch_is_taken_i
anchors.why: Resolved taken outcome training BHT counters and history.

anchors.name: branch_pc_i
anchors.why: Resolved branch target written into BTB target array.

groups.name: branch_target_buffer
groups.description: Associative BTB lookup/update with LFSR replacement on allocation.

groups.name: branch_history_table
groups.description: Saturating counter table and global history predicting branch direction.

groups.name: return_address_stack
groups.description: Speculative and committed RAS pointers with return address storage.

groups.name: next_pc_select
groups.description: Selects RAS, BTB target or sequential next fetch PC and taken slot.

groups.name: branch_update_port
groups.description: Resolved branch info training BTB, BHT and RAS.
